File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Trim carriage returns (`\r`) from lines in `src/ingest/parser.ts` so that Windows-style line endings (`\r\n`) do not leave a trailing `\r` on the last line or any row, which causes column count mismatches.
args.title: Trim trailing carriage returns in src/ingest/parser.ts

args.body:
label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

When parsing files with Windows line endings (`\r\n`), `text.split("\n")` leaves trailing carriage return characters (`\r`) on each line, which leads to `fields.length !== header.length` column count mismatches. We should trim carriage returns from the lines in `src/ingest/parser.ts` to ensure Windows-style line endings do not break parsing.
